title: RCF Test Suite
description: One file per Test Suite. Verifies one or more Acceptance Criteria (on the User Story identified by usId) via inline Test Cases. Test Suites hold the AC references; ACs stay clean of downstream references. Test-run status per TC is authored (Phase 3.7) and later derived from real test runs (Phase 6+).

id.description: Test Case identifier. TS suffix (three-digit minimum, unbounded above) joined to a lowercase alphanumeric slug (hyphens allowed).

testPointer.description: Optional pointer to the executable test, format: filePath::testName.

scope.description: Scope this test case exercises (library, runtime, deployed, unclassified). Optional at schema level; ruleset-enforcing consumers may require the TC scope to be equal to or wider than the covered AC's scope.

profile.description: Runtime execution profile the test case actually addressed. mock: the boundary is replaced entirely, no outbound traffic. stub: a stand-in the test controls, localhost only. fixture: replayed responses (cassette or MSW). live: the real third-party service or its provider sandbox. mixed: multiple probes with different profiles; anti-pattern flag pending expansion into finer TCs.

envVarsRequired.description: Environment variable names the test genuinely reads at runtime. Empty array means the test does not read env.

externalHostsReached.description: Hostnames the test actually reached over the wire. Empty for mock, stub, and fixture profiles. Never contains a URL with credentials.

notes.description: One-line free text describing the test's runtime shape. Never contains a token, key, or password.

runtimeProvenance.description: Per-test-case record of the runtime the test addressed. Optional at schema level; enforced at build-side coverage-strict when the covering AC binds a service attestation.
